page.title: My profile
page.unavailable: We can't display your profile right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
page.noStorefront: Your profile isn't open for editing yet. Please come back later: nothing is asked of you for now.

alias.name: Profile {alias}
alias.explain: Brands see you as {alias} until an introduction is opened.
alias.reveal: Your handle, your links and your exact figures are only shared with them at that point, and with them alone.
alias.forLife: Your alias is assigned for life: neither you nor INFLUX can change it.
alias.none: Your alias will be assigned when your profile opens.

layer.revealed: Visible only after an introduction is opened.
layer.internal: Visible only to you and the INFLUX team.

blocks.missingCount: {count, plural, one {# item to complete} other {# items to complete}}
blocks.allSet: All the information asked for is filled in.

home.remaining: {count, plural, one {# item left to complete:} other {# items left to complete:}}

required.headline: short title
required.profileUrl: profile link on the main network
required.followers: follower count on the main network
required.mainAudienceShare: share of that country in your audience

field.limitReached: Limit reached: untick a choice to pick another.

headline.label: Short title
headline.help: Your activity in one line, 20 to 120 characters. No handle, no @, no link, no brand name.

bio.label: Bio
bio.help: 150 to 800 characters. Every registered brand reads it: no handle, no link, no contact details.

collaborationExperience.label: Experience of brand collaborations
collaborationExperience.help: A range is enough: don't name any brand.

contactEmail.label: Contact e-mail
contactEmail.help: Optional: your sign-in address is used otherwise.

city.label: City of residence
city.help: It is never shared with brands.

formats.label: Formats offered
formats.help: Tick the formats you offer, network by network.

usageIncluded.label: Usage rights included
usageIncluded.help: The rights you grant from the start. No box ticked: no right is granted from the start.

usageOptional.label: Usage rights as an option
usageOptional.help: The rights you can grant on top, to discuss with your sales contact. A right is in one of the two lists only.

maxExclusivity.label: Sector exclusivity accepted
maxExclusivity.help: The longest period during which you agree not to work with a competing brand.

acceptsNonMonetary.label: Non-monetary counterpart accepted
acceptsNonMonetary.help: Products, services or invitations in exchange for content. It does not replace the discussion with your sales contact.

availability.label: Availability
availability.help: It is always shown with the date it was declared.

refusedSectors.label: Sectors you refuse
refusedSectors.help: No brand and no message is told of it, and nothing is counted: this choice stays between you and the INFLUX team.

figures.confirmAll: All three figures are filled in: press “Confirm my figures” to date them today.
figures.confirmSome: Please also fill in how often you post and your average comments, then press “Confirm my figures” to date your figures today.
figures.stale: Check your figures then confirm them: they date from {date}. After 90 days, your profile is shown lower in results.

issues.unknown: This choice is no longer available: please pick another.
issues.duplicate: This value already exists: please remove the duplicate.
issues.wrong_network: This link doesn't match the chosen network.
issues.sum_exceeds_100: The total is {sum}%, 100 at most. Nothing is saved for this network until the total is corrected.
issues.count: Enter a whole number, zero or more.
issues.percentage: Enter a percentage between 0 and 100, with two decimals at most.
issues.url_shape: The link must start with https:// and contain no space or credentials.
issues.share: Enter a whole percentage from 0 to 100.
issues.share_min: Another country weighs 10 % of your audience at least.

errors.identifierInText: Your text contains what looks like a handle, a link or an identifier. Please remove it: it will be shared once the introduction is opened.

save.retry: Changes not saved — trying again in 5 s.

networks.unavailable: We cannot show your networks right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
networks.intro: One line per network. Your handle, links and exact figures are only shared once an introduction is opened; until then brands see bands only.
networks.empty: No network yet. Start with your main network: that is where your followers are counted.
networks.failed: This action did not go through. Please try again in a moment.

add.label: Add a network
add.help: One line per account: two accounts on the same network are fine, never the same handle twice.

primary.label: Main account
primary.help: Only one account is the main one: it is the first brands read.
primary.moved: {to} is now your main account; {from} no longer is.

bands.notYet: Brands don't see a band yet: fill in this figure.

handle.label: Handle on the network
handle.help: Your public identifier on this network.

profileUrl.label: Link to your profile
profileUrl.help: It starts with https:// and leads to the chosen network.

pseudonym.label: Pseudonym
pseudonym.help: Your stage name, if it differs from your handle.

followers.label: Followers
followers.help: How many followers this account has today.

reach.label: Average reach per post
reach.help: The average number of people reached by a post.

engagement.label: Engagement rate (%)
engagement.help: Between 0 and 100, up to two decimals.

priorityMetrics.explain: Brands first see the band of these three figures; the exact figure comes later.

posts30d.hint: Count your posts from the last 30 days: posts, Reels, videos, Shorts. Do not count stories or live streams.

comments.hint: Average the comments on your last 12 posts, leaving out giveaways.

engagement.unverified: Your engagement rate is not shown to brands until INFLUX has verified it.

offer.negotiation: Costs are negotiated with your sales contact.
offer.otherNetworks: Other networks ({count, plural, =0 {no format ticked} one {# format ticked} other {# formats ticked}})
offer.sectorsFold: Choose the refused sectors ({count, plural, =0 {none chosen} one {# chosen} other {# chosen}})
offer.availabilityDeclared: Declared on {date}. Update it when it changes.

audience.intro: These percentages describe your audience, not you. Before any introduction, brands only see bands; your exact percentages are shared with them afterwards. What is missing to reach 100 % shows as "others": INFLUX never fills it in for you.
audience.noLines: First add a network in the "Social networks" block: the audience is filled in network by network.

countries.mainShare: Share of your audience in this country (%)
countries.otherShare: Share of your audience in other country {index} (%, 10 at least)

band.18_24: Share of your audience aged 18 to 24 (%)
band.25_34: Share of your audience aged 25 to 34 (%)
band.35_44: Share of your audience aged 35 to 44 (%)
band.45_plus: Share of your audience aged 45 and over (%)

genders.legend: Women, men and others in your audience

share.other: Share of your audience: others or not declared (%)

portfolio.notice: Your approved visuals are visible to every registered brand, before any introduction.
portfolio.pending: This visual is being reviewed. It is not visible to brands yet.
portfolio.brandConsent: I confirm I am allowed to name this brand and publish this visual.
portfolio.brandConsentHelp: Without this box, the caption is published without the brand name, or refused.
portfolio.faceNotice: A face is allowed, but it can let someone find you through an image search.
portfolio.replacementPending: Replacement being reviewed: the current visual stays shown.
portfolio.captionPending: Caption being reviewed: the previous one stays shown.
portfolio.count: {count, plural, one {# of 8 visual uploaded} other {# of 8 visuals uploaded}}
portfolio.full: You have uploaded 8 visuals, the maximum: replace one to change it.
portfolio.minimum: A published profile keeps at least 3 visuals: replace this one rather than removing it.
portfolio.caption: Caption (optional, 200 characters at most)
portfolio.help: PNG, JPEG or WebP, 8 MB at most, 320 px at least on the longest side. Hidden information in the file (location, device) is removed when you upload.
portfolio.empty: No visual uploaded yet. At least 3 are needed.
portfolio.unavailable: We cannot show your portfolio right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
portfolio.replacementAlt: Preview of the replacement visual, being reviewed
portfolio.deleteAfter: The rejected file will be deleted on {date}.

reason.watermark: The visual carries a watermark, a signature or a personal logo.
reason.handle_in_image: The visual shows an at sign, an account name or a handle.
reason.app_interface: The visual shows an app interface: profile banner, avatar or comments.
reason.text_naming_account_or_brand: Text in the visual names your account, or a brand without your authorisation statement.
reason.identifiable_place: The visual makes a place recognisable: a shop sign, a number plate, a street number or a known location.
reason.statistics_screenshot: A statistics screenshot is not allowed in the portfolio: it shows your handle.
reason.illicit_content: The visual goes against the law or INFLUX's terms of use.
reason.caption_identifier: The caption contains a handle, an at sign, a link or a name.
reason.caption_brand_unauthorised: The caption names a brand without your statement that you are allowed to.

status.uploaded: Visual uploaded: it is being reviewed.
status.captionPending: Caption sent: it will be visible once the INFLUX team has reviewed it.

errors.empty: This file is empty. Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
errors.tooLarge: This file is over 8 MB. Choose a lighter image, in PNG, JPEG or WebP format.
errors.unsupported_type: This format is not accepted. Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP image (no PDF).
errors.undecodable: This image cannot be read. Try another PNG, JPEG or WebP file.
errors.too_many_pixels: This image is too large: 4,096 px per side at most.
errors.too_small: This image is too small: its longest side must be at least 320 px.
errors.output_too_large: This image is still too heavy after processing. Choose a simpler image.
errors.quota: You have reached the number of uploads allowed for today. Please try again later.
errors.portfolio_full: You have uploaded 8 visuals, the maximum: replace one to change it.
errors.portfolio_minimum: A published profile keeps at least 3 visuals: replace this one rather than removing it.
errors.not_replaceable: This visual cannot be replaced: only an approved visual can be.
errors.replacement_pending: A replacement of this visual is already being reviewed.
errors.item_state: This visual changed in the meantime. The list is up to date: check it, then try again.
errors.profile_state: Your profile can no longer be edited: the portfolio cannot change.
errors.conflict: This action is no longer possible: the portfolio was just reviewed. Check the list.
errors.captionInvalid: A caption fits on one line, 200 characters at most.
errors.unavailable: This action did not go through: the service is not answering. Please try again in a moment.

publish.submitted: Profile submitted for review. Answer within 1 business day.
publish.missing: {count, plural, one {# piece of information is} other {# pieces of information are}} missing to publish your profile: {fields}.
publish.review: An INFLUX salesperson reviews your profile before publishing it.
publish.failed: Your profile could not be submitted. Please try again in a moment.

frozen.pending_review: Your profile is being reviewed: it cannot be edited until the INFLUX team replies.
frozen.suspended: Your profile is suspended: it cannot be edited for now.

status.published: Your profile is published. Only its anonymous version, under your alias, can be shown to brands.
status.pendingWithPublished: Your changes are being reviewed. Your profile remains visible in its previous version.
status.revisionKept: Your profile stays visible in its previous version.

refusal.fix: Correct it from your INFLUX space: your correction will be reviewed in turn.
refusal.contact: To discuss it, contact INFLUX from the help on the sign-in screen.

rejection.identifier_in_text: Your headline or bio contains a handle, an at sign, a link or a name. This information is only visible once an introduction is opened.
rejection.bio_insufficient: Your bio does not let a brand understand what you do.
rejection.portfolio_insufficient: At least 3 uploaded items are needed to publish your profile.
rejection.portfolio_non_compliant: One or more of your visuals make it possible to identify you.
rejection.network_link_inconsistent: The link you entered does not match the network you chose.
rejection.figures_inconsistent: The figures you entered are not consistent with each other.
rejection.topic_inconsistent: The topic you chose does not match the content you show.
rejection.illicit_content: The content of your profile cannot be published: it goes against the law or INFLUX's terms of use.
rejection.age_doubt: INFLUX is for adults only: we cannot publish your profile as it stands.
rejection.other: The message from the INFLUX team:

trust.verified: Your account is verified by INFLUX.
trust.missing: An account verified by INFLUX is needed to publish your profile. You ask for it from the “Social networks” block, on the line of your main network.

visibility.label: Visible in search
visibility.on: Brands will be able to find you in search, once your profile is published.
visibility.off: You are hidden from search: you will no longer receive requests from brands.
visibility.failed: This setting could not be saved. Please try again in a moment.

preview.title: What a brand sees
preview.explain: Exactly what the platform serves a brand, nothing more.
preview.unavailable: We cannot show the preview right now. Try again in a few minutes.
preview.notPublished: Your profile is not published yet: no brand sees it. This is what a brand would see once it is.
preview.beforeIntro: Before an introduction, a brand sees ranges only: no handle, no link, no exact figure.
preview.afterIntro: After an introduction, the brand also reads your handle, the link to your profile and your exact figures, with their source and date. Never your e-mail or your phone number.

afterEmpty.noNetwork: For now, a brand introduced to you would see the same card as before: your card does not show any network yet. Once a network is on it, the brand will also read its handle, its link and your exact figures. Never your e-mail or your phone number.
afterEmpty.nothingIdentified: For now, a brand introduced to you would see the same card as before: the networks on your card have no handle, link or exact figure to show yet. Never your e-mail or your phone number.

preview.noVisual: No approved visual yet: your card is shown without an image.
preview.observed: Figures observed by INFLUX: they are not shown in this preview.
